514:t_2:47.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「Advance! We'll clear out anyone who gets in the way of our mission!」

514:t_2:51.en:
$n
(What is this lack of resistance...? They don't feel like people who've had combat training...)

514:t_2:52.en:
$n
(Could it be that even in mobile weapon combat, they rely only on their machines' performance...?)

514:t_2:55.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「...To think we'd meet again in a place like this...」

514:t_2:57.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Right now I'm $$コード：ホワイト$$... a strike team member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

514:t_2:59.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Though we're descendants of the Reformists, we came to purge the $$プラント$$ that cooperates with the Empire.」

514:t_2:60.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Although it seems the assassination squad for the VIPs got taken out by you.」

514:t_2:61.en:
$n
「...Please tell me. Why is $$マキ#pilot$$ with $$クロノ$$...」

514:t_2:62.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I became a member around last April... They scouted me, saying I had potential.」

514:t_2:64.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「That's right. I joined $$クロノ$$ to change the world.」

514:t_2:65.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I never thought I'd end up fighting you, though...」

514:t_2:66.en:
$n
「Was what you told me on $$翠の地球$$ a lie!?」

514:t_2:67.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「A lie...? I never told one.」

514:t_2:68.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I'm both the nurse $$柏葉真紀$$ and $$クロノ$$'s $$コード：ホワイト$$.」

514:t_2:69.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Until the Captain gave orders, I was just a nurse working in Japan.」

514:t_2:70.en:
$n
「What does 'change the world' even mean!? Does it have something to do with the Reformists' 'watching over humanity's evolution'!?」

514:t_2:71.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You don't need to know that. We just follow Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s orders.」

514:t_2:72.en:
$n
「That's absurd! You joined $$クロノ$$ without even knowing what it does!?」

514:t_2:75.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain is worthy of trust... Isn't that enough?」

514:t_2:77.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「This is a good chance, $n. I'll forgive you for raising your sword against the Captain.」

514:t_2:78.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「So come with me. I'm sure the Captain will take you in if you apologize.」

514:t_2:80.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Let's go, $n. ...Or won't you listen to my request?」

514:t_2:83.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain and I can embrace you.」

514:t_2:86.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Why can't you listen to the Captain's words...」

514:t_3:3.en: ～ $$プラント$$ Defense Committee Chairman's Office ～

514:t_3:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「You're very calm. Did you know we were coming?」

514:t_3:8.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「...I was only prepared for the day I'd face you like this.」

514:t_3:9.en:
$$シン$$
「Then you must know why we came here!」

514:t_3:10.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「No matter what you say, you can't stop me.」

514:t_3:11.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I will carry on $$ギル$$'s will and see the $$デスティニープラン$$ through to completion.」

514:t_3:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「So that's... why you joined hands with $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

514:t_3:14.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「At the very least, that man approves of my plan.」

514:t_3:15.en:
$$シン$$
「Why, $$レイ#pt136$$!? During the $$多元戦争$$, we rejected the Chairman's plan!」

514:t_3:16.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The $$デスティニープラン$$... A system in which society presents each person with the optimal life, according to their genetic information...」

514:t_3:17.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Neither you nor $$フル・フロンタル$$ know its true meaning.」

514:t_3:18.en:
$$キラ$$
「The true meaning of the $$デスティニープラン$$...」

514:t_3:19.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「That's right... After I left $$ザフト$$, I devoured the materials $$ギル$$ left behind while I was recuperating.」

514:t_3:20.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「They covered not only matters of official business, but private ones as well.」

514:t_3:21.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「And then I met $$フル・フロンタル$$, who is in a similar situation.」

514:t_3:23.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ is a clone of $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

514:t_3:25.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「This meeting was no coincidence. He probably approached me for his own purposes.」

514:t_3:26.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「But that worked out well for me too, since I sought to carry on $$ギル$$'s aspirations.」

514:t_3:27.en:
$$シン$$
「What the hell is it!? What the Chairman was trying to do... the true meaning of the $$デスティニープラン$$!」

514:t_3:28.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「...I will tell you the truth.」

514:t_3:29.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The true meaning of the $$デスティニープラン$$... It is a plan to open up humanity's future...」

514:t_3:30.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It is meant to find humanity awakened to new power, and to protect it from $$クロノ$$.」

514:t_3:32.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Yes. $$ギル$$ tried to fulfill his mission as a $$クロノ$$ Reformist in a form apart from the $$コーディネイター$$s.」

514:t_3:33.en:
$$シン$$
「What do you mean, humanity awakened to new power!? Something like $$ニュータイプ$$s or $$イノベイター$$s!?」

514:t_3:34.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Can't you tell, $$シン$$? It's you, $$キラ・ヤマト$$, and $$アスラン・ザラ$$ and the others.」

514:t_3:36.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Didn't you find it strange? That $$ギル$$, the Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Council, took such special interest in you...」

514:t_3:37.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「and that he watched $$キラ$$'s movements more closely than necessary, trying to bring you into contact with each other.」

514:t_3:39.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It seems that was also meant to draw out the potential sleeping within you.」
